testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel component selection for a drawing layout ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔ Given the active document is `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenPart.opd` in the MCAD Software ✔ And the new-document template chooser is open ✔ And `fixtures/cad/document-creation-layout-candidate/English/Populated Layout.odd` is available as the populated inch assembly layout ✔ When the user selects the inch drawing template ✔ Then the chooser displays the template sheet and available layout previews ✔ When the user selects the populated assembly layout preview ✔ And the user chooses Create ✔ Then the template chooser closes ✔ And a component-selection dialog opens for a drawing view ✔ And the dialog displays a document name field and a browse control ✔ And it offers OK and Cancel ✔ When the user cancels component selection ✔ Then the component-selection dialog closes ✔ And the original part document remains active ✔ And no new drawing tab is displayed
